title: Card roles and settings

request.details: GET settings_version, context, options and settings choices. {{route:cards.roles.update}} with changed roles/settings and expected_settings_version. Send the GET context as expected_context when applicable. Use from_group for a user-named group. Explicit roles override it. A null setting restores the default.

response: Changes to the card placed by this chat are saved atomically. GET again to confirm the applied selections.
errors: On 403 chat_card_not_owned check the returned node keys. On 409 gate_context_changed or node_settings_locked refresh the state. On 422 role_not_applicable, ai_not_selectable, setting_not_applicable or not_a_choice inspect the allowed values.
